import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10**7)

large_INF = 10**18
total_result = 0
memo_table = []

def compute_min_moves(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n < len(memo_table) and memo_table[n]:
        return memo_table[n]
    min_difference = large_INF
    val = 1
    move_count = 0
    while abs(val - n) <= min_difference:
        min_difference = abs(val - n)
        val = val * 10 + 1
        move_count += 1
    val //= 10
    if val > n and val // 10:
        if n < len(memo_table):
            return min(
                move_count + compute_min_moves(abs(val - n)),
                move_count - 1 + compute_min_moves(abs(val // 10 - n))
            )
        return min(
            move_count + compute_min_moves(abs(val - n)),
            move_count - 1 + compute_min_moves(abs(val // 10 - n))
        )
    if n < len(memo_table):
        return min(
            move_count + compute_min_moves(abs(val - n)),
            0
        )
    return move_count + compute_min_moves(abs(val - n))

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.read())
    global memo_table
    memo_table = [0] * int(1e7)
    print(compute_min_moves(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
